title: Shadownet Credential JWT payload
description: Payload of a shadownet-cred+jwt. Defined in rfcs/0001-shadownet.md §6.1. The JWS header MUST be { alg: 'EdDSA', typ: 'shadownet-cred+jwt' } and is not covered by this schema.

iss.description: Issuer's domain. Must be authorized to issue for `org` per §6.6 (same-domain, sub-domain, or DNS delegate).

sub.description: The Shadowname being attested. Canonical lowercase, local@provider per §5.1.

kind.description: Attestation kind. v0.2 defines exactly one.

org.description: Organization (domain) the Shadowname is affiliated with.

exp.description: Expiry, Unix seconds. Conformance suite enforces exp - iat ≤ 2592000 (30 days) for `org_affiliation` per §6.3.

epoch.description: Revocation list epoch identifier. The status list is fetched from https://<iss>/.well-known/shadownet/status/<epoch>.

idx.description: Bit index in the status list bitstring.
